topic: Memory Web branch and skill-point clearance
currentUserGoal: Keep Memory Web branches from crossing or overlapping and prevent skill points from overlapping visually at zoomed-in overview levels.
workCompleted: Removed the independently bent QuadraticBezier connector paths that could cross nodes despite the straight-edge graph test passing.
Rendered every connector as a straight branch clipped outside both endpoint glow radii, with a shared connector gap.
Expanded world-space layout coordinates by 30 percent while preserving the organic Fit silhouette, making node frames and labels less crowded at useful zoom levels.
Repositioned rank and mode satellites around Field Mouse, Bee Hive, Earthworm Crew, Sheep Loop, and Meadow Rabbit so the production-chain trunk and local branches remain unobstructed.
Delayed rank/status copy until 3.25x zoom; 2.5x now shows skill names without stacking every status line.
Upgraded Memory Web tests from center-distance checks to actual glow-radius separation, branch-to-unrelated-node clearance, non-crossing branches, and minimum branch fan-out at shared hubs.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 125 Vitest tests across 17 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
The focused EcosystemMemoryTree suite passed seven tests, including visual-radius spacing, branch crossings, unrelated-node clearance, and shared-hub fan-out.
The live Memory Grove was screenshot-verified at Fit, 1.4x, 1.8x, and 2.5x in the in-app browser.
Responsive browser checks covered 1280x720 and 390x844; the canvas matched each requested viewport.
Browser diagnostics contained no errors or warnings.
The sampled Memory Grove state held about 116 FPS with zero frame spikes, 741 display objects, and about 0.03 ms average frame work.

release.status: Local ecosystem prototype checkpoint; not pushed, merged into master, or promoted to production.

currentGitStatus: The Memory Web clearance implementation, tests, and handoff are committed together on codex/ecosystem-factory-prototype.
docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains an unrelated untracked file and must stay untouched unless the user explicitly requests it.
The local Vite server remains available at http://127.0.0.1:5173.
knownIssues: Decorative helper-territory contours intentionally overlap at their edges; progression branches and skill nodes do not.
Late-game locked nodes remain deliberately subdued at Fit zoom and may need a later contrast pass after more of the web is playable.
Future cross-links will need explicit positions because automatic graph layout is not part of this prototype.
nextRecommendedSteps: Have the user inspect the revised 2.5x overview and pan through each helper cluster.
Continue the ecosystem loop with the first Field Mouse resource-chain objective and visible production activity after visual approval.
Extend the radius and branch-clearance tests whenever new Memory nodes or cross-links are introduced.
doNotRevert: Keep rendered branches straight and radius-clipped so production geometry exactly matches test geometry.
Do not restore independently bent cached curves unless collision validation is upgraded to inspect the rendered curves themselves.
Keep node spacing based on visual glow radii rather than a fixed center-distance constant.
Keep branch-to-node clearance and shared-hub fan-out regression tests.
Keep status text hidden until 3.25x while allowing selected and hovered nodes to reveal their details earlier.
